Now command_lint.cc. Convert:
```cpp
      sourcemeta::jsonschema::LOG_VERBOSE(options)
          << "warning: Cannot exclude unknown rule: " << *iterator << "\n";
```
to
```cpp
      sourcemeta::jsonschema::LOG_WARNING()
          << "Cannot exclude unknown rule: " << *iterator << "\n";
```
And include comment: `#include <iostream> // std::cerr, std::cout` -> `// std::cout`.

Wait, after this, command_lint.cc still uses `sourcemeta::jsonschema::LOG_VERBOSE(options)` in the if branch. fine.

Note that LOG_WARNING writes prefix and returns cerr. Good.
